gdp_level.label: GDP, current prices, not seasonally adjusted (PSA quarterly national accounts, OpenSTAT)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, constant 2018 prices, seasonally adjusted (PSA seasonally adjusted national accounts, OpenSTAT)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, change on previous quarter, seasonally adjusted (PSA, OpenSTAT)

gdp_growth_yoy.label: Real GDP growth, change on same quarter a year earlier, not seasonally adjusted (PSA quarterly national accounts; PSA's headline)

cpi.label: CPI, all income households, all items, change on same month a year earlier, 2018=100 (PSA, OpenSTAT)

cpi_mom.label: CPI, all items, change on previous month, not seasonally adjusted, from PSA's all-items index (OpenSTAT)

policy_rate.label: BSP target reverse repurchase rate, end of month (BIS central bank policy rates, M.PH)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate, not seasonally adjusted (PSA labour force survey, OpenSTAT)

participation.label: Labour force participation rate, not seasonally adjusted (PSA labour force survey, OpenSTAT)

employment.label: Employment-to-population ratio, not seasonally adjusted, computed from PSA's participation and employment rates (PSA labour force survey)

exports.label: Exports of goods, FOB, US$ converted to pesos at the BIS monthly average rate (IMF international trade in goods, from PSA)

imports.label: Imports of goods, CIF, US$ converted to pesos at the BIS monthly average rate (IMF international trade in goods, from PSA)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports FOB less imports CIF, pesos (IMF ITG, converted at the BIS monthly average rate)
